fields.summary_ko.0: JPMorgan Chase's Q3 results fell short of expectations for the first time since 2023, with 2026 net interest income (NII) guidance raised to $10.62 billion, share buybacks reduced, and dividends increased.
fields.summary_ko.1: Based on 2029 target revenue of $22.71 billion and net income of $6.88 billion, net income is expected to grow from $6.36 billion assuming annual growth of 6.8% from current levels, with 12% upside relative to current fair value.
